item.title: India Walton no longer running for lieutenant governor as Delgado suspends campaign
item.description: BUFFALO, N.Y. (WIVB) — Former Buffalo mayoral candidate India Walton is no longer running for lieutenant governor after current lieutenant governor Antonio Delgado ended his gubernatorial campaign on Tuesday. Delgado announced Walton as his running mate last week. He was set to challenge current New York governor Kathy Hochul in the Democratic primary in June. [...]
